name: Athos
detailed_description:
The year is 1814. A time of steel and honor—of knights, warriors, and forgotten empires. Your ship has crashed. The wreckage smolders behind you as you awaken, disoriented and alone on the shores of a strange, uncharted island. The ground rumbles beneath your body—heavy, thunderous footsteps draw near. A towering T-Rex emerges from the jungle mist. Yet somehow… you’re not afraid. What truly unsettles you is the void in your mind—you remember nothing of who you were or what led you here.

Welcome to Athos, a primal world where dinosaurs never went extinct. Instead, they evolved alongside humanity, forging a brutal and beautiful land untouched by time. Shipwrecked and with no memory of your past, you must learn to survive in this savage wilderness. Gather resources, craft weapons, and tame powerful dinosaurs to stand by your side. As you grow stronger and carve out a life on this dangerous island, echoes of your forgotten past begin to resurface. Why did your ship crash? Why were you spared? And what ancient force slumbers beneath Athos, waiting to be awakened?

Upon starting, each player is dropped into the vast and diverse landscapes of the prehistoric world of Athos. The game world is teeming with various species of dinosaurs, from the towering Tyrannosaurus rex to the nimble Velociraptor. Armed with only primitive tools and their wits, players must quickly gather resources like wood, stone, and food to build shelters, craft weapons, and stay alive.

Surviving the game means facing the ever-present danger of dinosaurs. Some dinosaurs can be tamed and used as mounts, providing players with a distinct advantage, while others are relentless predators that require careful strategy to defeat. Players can team up to take down larger threats or go solo to hone their survival skills.

Throughout the game, players can collect blueprints and rare resources to craft more advanced weapons, armor, and tools. As players level up, they gain access to new abilities and skills that aid in combat and survival. Choose your playstyle and tailor your character to dominate the primordial landscape.

Athos immerses players in a thrilling survival adventure where they must navigate a perilous alien world, interact with majestic yet dangerous dinosaurs, and uncover the mysteries that lie beneath the surface. With its dynamic gameplay, and rich narrative elements, the game offers an unforgettable journey of exploration, adaptation, and survival in the face of daunting odds.

short_description: Welcome to a captivating journey into the world of Athos. Build a formidable base to protect yourself from the wild and unpredictable environment, and master the art of taming mighty dinosaurs to be your loyal companions. Welcome to a world where survival is not just a choice but a way of life!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400/AMD FX-8320 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 2GB/AMD Radeon HD 7870 2GB or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700 CPU @ 3.00GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
